title: Guide 6. How to Edit Main Menu & Dropdown Links
text:
## Guide 6. How to Edit Main Menu & Dropdown Links
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000019749

## Where Can I Access This Tool?
Inside Toolbox » Menu Manager:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128422033/original/Bq0zymkHru_FsOxzLEJt7a742fM-2TZNaQ.png?1689466321 | alt: ]

## What are the Default Menu Options?
By default, the Menu Manager comes with 5 different menu options.

## Header Main Menu
Accessible via / home
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128423065/original/FI6mfWmd76sJFB5zFagOi8acHxciU44lSw.png?1689471148 | alt: ]

## Pricing Page Menu
Is accessible via / join
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128423084/original/gr35Dn21A656N-JVykMfuVa5JdiWSqzEvA.png?1689471280 | alt: ]

## Footer Menu
Is accessible on any page by the default
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128423094/original/RjqCnna5sva8jiYRRCbPcVzn626ZXS36wQ.png?1689471312 | alt: ]

## Header Mini Nav
Is accessible via / home
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128423100/original/cw0t91GnAzFgI1OBfpdc-0SApALp8yHFkw.png?1689471392 | alt: ]

## Login Page Links
Is accessible via /login
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128423132/original/CUaSfmcpF_VwfTxvfDxkSNAH0WdbvwNZJQ.png?1689471431 | alt: ]

## How Can I Edit These Menus?
By simply clicking on " Customize " under Actions on the preferred menu element.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128423163/original/S8_JSjmxqaC-vLyAIMXRwZo9lFq93tWzQg.png?1689471502 | alt: ]
In this instance, let's make changes to the " Main Menu "
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128423217/original/bXTaxFLl9N5Xe8NwhZb2dK7GoIfWA7QRgw.png?1689471968 | alt: ]
Add an additional link by clicking on the "New Link+" button:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128423233/original/pf5bbhcG8NbkX8BMZTlz3khRK8-C-Xip_Q.png?1689472125 | alt: ]
Once the text and the URL are added click " Save Changes ".
Once saved, the edited menu will start appearing above the Default Menus , an indication of its being a Custom Menu :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12093729178/original/hQjrfZaIzZnVDT5g_Wb-fSsme8EDX2tlhg.jpeg?1623109945 | alt: ]
When clicked on "Edit" on Custom Menus:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12093729183/original/c0I8PWftc0BjFTZ1i9UGCt9gN2QuIfSqkA.jpeg?1623109946 | alt: ]
Under "Actions" there is a drop-down option called  "Edit Menu":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12093729176/original/YLNx2NqlYgG7LSEbMI-q6BB83oeg7dQYEQ.jpeg?1623109944 | alt: ]
Once clicked, a module will display where the Nickname and System Name can be assigned for the menu:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12093729172/original/Tnh_DwUAoGmUrjQd_dhC8oK_rRBiA9MqcA.png?1623109941 | alt: ]
Additionally, Custom Menus will have few options under Actions:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12093729186/original/i-VD2EJ_SFWIb_DBklp66aTKJ2mwUABA4w.jpeg?1623109947 | alt: ]
Clicking Disable will disable this custom menu and its default version will be used on the website. This is very helpful for troubleshooting purposes:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12093729174/original/GzcO81-1dUlvn1SBHbZ0KVHkBAG83w_mgA.jpeg?1623109943 | alt: ]
Clicking Clone will clone this custom menu and will assign a custom Menu Name and Shortcode:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12093729175/original/LNh5dvGGZKR3qmOKnT4KqOqxWDUiNc0D0Q.jpeg?1623109944 | alt: ]
Clicking Copy Shortcode will copy the shortcode of this custom menu, with this copied shortcode, it is easy to call the menu on the preferred location like in a webpage or a widget ( How To Call A Menu On A Webpage ).
Clicking Delete will delete this custom menu.

## How To Create Dropdown Menus
Indent the child element under the parent field, this can be accomplished by dragging the menu element under another:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128423451/original/ADoEnc8EAQzJJ_izX1-Zu0wgxpmlwdxvLA.png?1689473276 | alt: ]
After the new drop-downs are saved the menu will display a green button to expand and hide the options:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128423479/original/go_Rj3eVeqN269gaJFv1ckMbIBwZCZevCg.gif?1689473525 | alt: ]
The drop-down menu shows up in the front end:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128423522/original/eUxKspw9N7icR1ISQ6CCPX80DPYwgU8QEw.png?1689473576 | alt: ]

## More Editing Options For Menu Links
All menu links come with a " Settings " button that allows for further changes :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128423583/original/0COSDy8rEiafF2KC3Y22v8wJ7FL51UzwNw.png?1689473758 | alt: ]
Link Title Text
Menu Item Inline Attribute
Outer <li> Inline Attribute
Menu Item CSS Class
Outer <li> CSS Class
Additional checkbox options:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12128685789/original/3eSB6f5x_pjVJzaB5M90L9zFNmfNVPzXvA.png?1689886896 | alt: ]
Open in new window - This setting will indicate if the link should open in a new tab or not.
Add rel="nofollow" - This setting will indicate if search engines should follow this link or not.
Open Link - Open the URL of the menu item in a new tab.
Hide Item - This setting will hide the menu item from appearing on the front end but keep it inside the Menu.
